set.body:
Decide and implement the intrinsic-lattice versus ambient-frame geometry contract before Grid and Affine signatures stabilize.

Required spike
- Compare at least: Grid[F,I,W] with AffineEmbedding[I,W]; a common-case AffineIso[D]; and an explicitly limited D2-in-D2/D3-in-D3 scope.
- Exercise native D2 planes in D3 patient space, ordinary D3 volumes, dimension-dropping slices, NIfTI singleton dimensions, and existential/dynamic loading.
- Record the decision and migration effect on Sampled, Point, Vec, Grid, reference sampling, reframe4s, and locus4s.

If embeddings are accepted
- An embedding uses a rectangular homogeneous affine map.
- I = W has a full inverse.
- I < W defines a checked projection/pseudoinverse, an on-image residual test, and explicit off-plane failure.
- Common D3 volume construction remains concise.

Additional corrections
- fromOriginSpacingDirection validates orthonormal direction cosines or is renamed to basisRowMajor.
- Affine construction records/checks inverse residuals and exposes a configurable condition diagnostic.
- Rename rank-only Index to LatticeIndex and add a bounded grid-owned GridIndex; ContinuousIndex remains explicitly unbounded.

Acceptance criteria
- The choice is documented as a deliberate public scope decision.
- A later addition of D2-in-D3 would not require silently changing established coordinate meaning.
- Same-owner point/vector construction preserves singleton owner types; generic constructors cannot manufacture widened owners accidentally.
- pointAt makes bounded versus unbounded behavior explicit.

Tests
- Affine identity, inverse round trip, and composition associativity properties.
- D2-in-D3 oblique-plane round trips plus off-plane residual rejection if embeddings are supported.
- Direction orthonormality, reflection, anisotropic spacing, near-singular diagnostics, and inverse residual cases.
- Bounded-index construction and lattice/grid conversion properties, including overflow and every boundary.
- Compile-time tests reject dimension/frame mismatches and accidental widened construction.
- JVM/Scala.js differential geometry fixtures with canonical matrix/key checksums.
set.title: Decide intrinsic versus ambient geometry and harden affines
